description: This file defines the ImpactDataAdminController class, which manages admin actions for impact data entities within the Goteo project. It includes route definitions, CRUD actions (list, edit, delete), and integrates with ImpactData model and form classes.

classes.name: ImpactDataAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for managing impact data in the admin interface of Goteo. Handles listing, editing, adding, and deleting impact data records.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'communications' indicating this controller's categorization.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns the routing configuration for impact data admin actions.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of impact data entries with pagination.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles the creation and editing of impact data entries, including form processing.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Handles deletion of impact data entries.
